create-one-replacement.ps1
source:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='D:\LoaAlephPreparation\VM-PREP-SRC001-20260915-7a772f0\replacement-image-repair-20260916-fda0a0b'
$name='SRC001-PREP-REPLACEMENT-fda0a0b'
$out='\\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\tmp\src001-replacement-image-gate-20260916\provisioning\replacement-creation.json'
$r=[ordered]@{scope='SINGLE_AUTHORIZED_REPLACEMENT_VM_CREATION_NO_BOOT';repair_administration_id='IMAGE-REPAIR-SRC001-20260916-fda0a0b';started_at_utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');vm_creation_calls=0;boot_calls=0;mutations=@()}
try {
$all=@(Get-VM)
if($all.Count -ne 1 -or $all[0].Id.ToString() -ne 'd5913cd7-aa99-4695-96b7-0d0135bad386' -or $all[0].State.ToString() -ne 'Off'){throw 'STARTING_VM_INVENTORY_MISMATCH'}
if(@(Get-VMNetworkAdapter -VM $all[0]|Where-Object Connected).Count -ne 0){throw 'FAILED_VM_NIC_CONNECTED'}
if(Test-Path "$root\vm\creation-started.json"){throw 'CREATION_ALREADY_INITIATED_NO_RETRY_AUTHORITY'}
if((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 "$root\vm\executor.vhdx").Hash.ToLower() -ne 'c334c422fa7ea7b21defd3bebd0d419b3b36bd09785cbd530903f4d9557d90ce'){throw 'VHDX_PREBOOT_HASH_MISMATCH'}
if((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 "$root\vm\provisioning-seed.iso").Hash.ToLower() -ne 'a4986a2504f12d18a8cebe8d3c2726e68b408d9befc30951aaf5c0a2b0c46719'){throw 'SEED_HASH_MISMATCH'}
[ordered]@{repair='IMAGE-REPAIR-SRC001-20260916-fda0a0b';utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');name=$name}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content "$root\vm\creation-started.json" -Encoding UTF8
$r.vm_creation_calls=1
$vm=New-VM -Name $name -Generation 2 -MemoryStartupBytes 2GB -VHDPath "$root\vm\executor.vhdx" -Path "$root\vm" -SwitchName 'Default Switch'
$r.vm_id=$vm.Id.ToString()
$r.mutations+=@([ordered]@{operation='New-VM';vm_id=$r.vm_id;utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')})
Set-VMProcessor -VM $vm -Count 2
Set-VMMemory -VM $vm -DynamicMemoryEnabled $false -StartupBytes 2GB
Set-VM -VM $vm -AutomaticStartAction Nothing -AutomaticStopAction ShutDown -CheckpointType Disabled -AutomaticCheckpointsEnabled $false
Set-VMFirmware -VM $vm -EnableSecureBoot On -SecureBootTemplate MicrosoftUEFICertificateAuthority -FirstBootDevice (Get-VMHardDiskDrive -VM $vm)
Add-VMDvdDrive -VM $vm -ControllerNumber 0 -ControllerLocation 1 -Path "$root\vm\provisioning-seed.iso"
Disable-VMIntegrationService -VM $vm -Name 'Guest Service Interface','Key-Value Pair Exchange','Time Synchronization','VSS'
$r.mutations+=@([ordered]@{operation='Configure dedicated CPU/RAM/firmware/seed/restricted integration; no old VM mutation';utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')})
$vm=Get-VM -Id $r.vm_id
$r.vm=$vm|Select-Object Id,Name,@{N='State';E={$_.State.ToString()}},Generation,Version,Path,ConfigurationLocation,ProcessorCount,MemoryStartup,DynamicMemoryEnabled,@{N='AutomaticStartAction';E={$_.AutomaticStartAction.ToString()}},@{N='AutomaticStopAction';E={$_.AutomaticStopAction.ToString()}},@{N='CheckpointType';E={$_.CheckpointType.ToString()}},AutomaticCheckpointsEnabled,EnhancedSessionTransportType
$f=Get-VMFirmware -VM $vm
$r.firmware=[ordered]@{SecureBoot=$f.SecureBoot.ToString();SecureBootTemplate=$f.SecureBootTemplate;BootOrder=@($f.BootOrder|Select-Object BootType,Description,FirmwarePath)}
$r.disks=@(Get-VMHardDiskDrive -VM $vm|Select-Object Path,@{N='ControllerType';E={$_.ControllerType.ToString()}},ControllerNumber,ControllerLocation)
$r.vhd=Get-VHD -Path "$root\vm\executor.vhdx"|Select-Object Path,@{N='VhdFormat';E={$_.VhdFormat.ToString()}},@{N='VhdType';E={$_.VhdType.ToString()}},FileSize,Size,LogicalSectorSize,PhysicalSectorSize,DiskIdentifier,ParentPath,Attached
$r.nic=@(Get-VMNetworkAdapter -VM $vm|Select-Object Id,Name,MacAddress,SwitchId,SwitchName,Connected,DynamicMacAddressEnabled)
$r.dvd=@(Get-VMDvdDrive -VM $vm|Select-Object Path,ControllerNumber,ControllerLocation)
$r.integration=@(Get-VMIntegrationService -VM $vm|Select-Object Name,Enabled)
$r.com_ports=@(Get-VMComPort -VM $vm|Select-Object Name,Path)
$r.no_host_shares='No share, socket, pipe or enhanced-session transport configured by creation; guest channel inventory remains a later mandatory gate.'
if($vm.Generation -ne 2 -or $f.SecureBoot.ToString() -ne 'On' -or $f.SecureBootTemplate -ne 'MicrosoftUEFICertificateAuthority' -or $r.disks.Count -ne 1 -or $r.disks[0].ControllerType -ne 'SCSI'){throw 'CREATED_CONFIGURATION_GATE_FAILED'}
$r.result='PASS_CREATED_ONE_FRESH_GEN2_VM_OFF_NOT_BOOTED'
} catch {$r.result='FAIL_STOP_NO_REPLACEMENT_RETRY';$r.error=$_.Exception.Message}
$r.finished_at_utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$r|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content $out -Encoding UTF8
if($r.result -ne 'PASS_CREATED_ONE_FRESH_GEN2_VM_OFF_NOT_BOOTED'){exit 1}
